candidates.name: Binit Singh
candidates.headline: Software Development Engineer · BlueStone Jewellery
candidates.summary: SDE with 3+ years building scalable microservices and AI-powered products in production. M.Tech Gold Medalist from IIT BHU (10.00 CGPA). Delivered Rs. 30L SaaS savings, 24% revenue uplift, and 43% reduction in manual effort. Transitioning toward Applied AI.
candidates.narrative: Backend engineer with three years of production experience building microservices, event-driven systems, and AI-powered tooling at BlueStone Jewellery. Engineered TrueCRM from scratch — an in-house retail CRM that replaced a paid SaaS product, saving Rs. 30L annually and driving a 24% increase in customer turnover. Added an AI call-analysis layer using Kafka and Gemini LLM, reducing post-call manual effort by 43%. Alongside full-time work, independently launched Manga Colorizer Pro — a monetized AI SaaS platform that scaled to 2,000+ users and 100+ paid subscribers — and built AARA, a fully on-device Android AI assistant now live on Google Play. Academically exceptional: Gold Medalist and Rank 1 in M.Tech CSE at IIT BHU with a perfect 10.00 CGPA; AIR 270 in GATE CS out of 100,000+ candidates. Has a solid foundation in vector DBs and RAG from personal projects and is actively transitioning toward Applied AI roles. Will need some ramp-up on production LLM infrastructure depth but brings the right fundamentals and a strong track record of shipping.
candidates.raw_text: Software Development Engineer with 3+ years building scalable microservices, event-driven systems, and AI-powered products in production. Delivered measurable business outcomes including Rs. 30L annual SaaS savings, 24% revenue uplift, 43% reduction in manual effort, and 60% reduction in database footprint. M.Tech CSE Gold Medalist, IIT BHU.

candidate_experiences.title: Application Developer Intern
candidate_experiences.description: Built a KYC automation tool using Python and Tesseract-OCR to extract and validate user identity data from national ID cards, significantly reducing manual verification effort.

candidate_experiences.title: Software Development Engineer
candidate_experiences.description: Engineered TrueCRM, an in-house retail CRM ecosystem replacing external FreshSales SaaS — saving Rs. 30L annually and increasing customer turnover by 24%. Built an AI-driven call analysis microservice using Kafka and Gemini LLM, reducing manual post-call effort by 43%. Designed two native Android system apps (Dialer + RAT) integrated with Android Management API. Engineered a reusable Spring Boot archival framework adopted across 4+ services, reducing active DB footprint by ~60%. Set up end-to-end observability with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, Loki, and OpenTelemetry.
candidate_experiences.note: First full-time role post M.Tech; broad ownership across CRM, AI, mobile, and infra

candidate_projects.name: Manga Colorizer Pro
candidate_projects.summary: AI-powered manga colorization and super-resolution SaaS platform with browser-based reading workflows. Independently launched and monetized — scaled to 2,000+ users and 100+ paid subscribers via subscription model.

candidate_projects.name: AARA — Android Multi-Agent AI Assistant
candidate_projects.summary: Personalized hands-free Android AI assistant with multi-LLM routing and full on-device flow: Gemma LiteRT, Gemma embeddings, Piper/Sherpa-ONNX TTS, ObjectBox vector DB for RAG. Live on Google Play.

candidate_projects.name: Wireless Intrusion Detection System
candidate_projects.summary: Real-time wireless attack detection using GRU-based sequence modeling, achieving 98% accuracy on live traffic.

candidate_projects.name: Feedback Decentralized Application
candidate_projects.summary: Blockchain-based anonymous feedback platform with fine-tuned BERT deployed on Azure, React frontend, and Ethereum smart contract on Ropsten testnet.
